title: Preppy paper
description: The JSON format for a Preppy paper. A paper is checked against the pattern of the exam it is uploaded for: which sections it has, in what order, and how many questions each holds all come from that pattern unless the file says otherwise. This schema cannot know which exam you mean, so it accepts any of the six section codes in any order; the app is stricter.

date.description: The day this paper opens, YYYY-MM-DD. Its window is chosen when it is scheduled, not here: a day and a time for each end, and entry may close on the following morning. A paper that opens on the 28th and takes entry until 1 AM on the 29th is still the 28th's paper everywhere it is counted.

title.description: What students and the archive call this paper, and part of what identifies it: a paper is its exam, its date and its name, so two papers on one night must differ by name. Optional, and then the paper is known by its date -- but only one untitled paper can be scheduled per day per exam. The upload screen offers a name box that overrides whatever is here, so a file that names itself badly can be fixed without editing it, and a paper can be renamed afterwards from Manage.

sections.description: The sections of the exam this paper is for, in the order they are sat. Four on the pattern the product ships with (QUANT, REASONING, ENGLISH, PK); a track decides its own, so an editor cannot check the order and the app does.

questionCount.description: How many questions this section holds, when that differs from the default pattern. Omit to use the pattern. If given, it must equal the length of "questions".

directions.description: Shared material: a reading passage, a data table, or a puzzle. Applies to questions from..to inclusive.

to.description: Last question this material covers, inclusive.

text.description: Must contain something other than spaces.

table.description: Structured table data. Never rely on aligned spaces inside text; the browser collapses them.

number.description: Position within the paper: unique per section, continuous across the paper, and inside the band its section owns. The ceiling is four sections at the Paper pattern screen's own maximum of 200 a section, not the count of any one exam pattern.

text.description: At least 10 characters, not counting spaces at either end.

options.description: Four at least, five at most, keyed from A with no gaps. E is the only optional one.

difficulty.description: Leave it out rather than empty.
